Here is my audit report. --- # Audit Report: 第二批 v3 AI 学习教练全量落地 + P1 流程闭环补齐 ## Summary of what I verified **Verified as real and solid:** - **① typecheck**: `pnpm typecheck` exits with 0 errors. - **② tests**: 58/58 pass — 36 old + masteryService 3 (N=3 boundary, fail-reset, soft-mark linkage), snapshotRepo 3 (idempotent save), planRepo 4 (two-table CRUD + cascade), snapshotHistory 4 (dual-dimension aggregation), aiSchemas 8 (zod rejects invalid enum/mode/missing fields). sessionHistory 4 green. No test invokes the test runner (reject-class fork-bomb pattern absent). - **③ smoke**: 51 assertions pass in a temp DATA_DIR, including v3 table CRUD (mastery streak→mastered, snapshot idempotency, plan two-table, diagnosis save/read). - **④**: `git diff c6d5dea..HEAD` on package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml = 0 lines; docker/nginx/compose = 0 lines; schema diff adds exactly the 5 new tables, zero changes to existing tables, no new attempts index (only `idx_snapshots_bank`/`idx_tasks_plan`/`idx_plans_bank` on new tables). - **Slice 0 reconciliation**: `specs/design-reconciliation-2026-08-10.md` finalizes T1–T8/R1–R8; shared/types.ts matches (FinishPracticeResponse={scorecard,snapshotId}, GradeResponse.mastered optional, DiagnosisResult flat, TrendPoint `{ts,...}` per slice1-code authority). `snapshotRepo.save` object-param → `InsightSnapshot|null`. graded endpoint does not construct `mastered`. - **⑤ remote E2E**: evidence file `specs/verification/VERIFICATION-2026-08-10-第二批-v3远程端到端.md` documents all sub-items (REST panel 17 attempts/2 weakTags, trend 1 point, 11 diagnosis rows, 1 plan/8 tasks, one-click session, mastered:true on 3rd correct, wrong-book linkage, 204/404, error frame, 2 history rounds). - **⑦ regression**: `localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY)` retained in QuizPage.finish (3 call sites), graded endpoint untouched, first-batch evidence file present. - Working tree has uncommitted changes vs 9869efb, but `git diff -w` shows they are purely prettier reformatting (quotes/indent/wrapping) — no logic change. **Blocking gap found — contract item ⑥-① not satisfied:** The contract requires: **"薄弱点点击→错题本带 tag 筛选打开"** (clicking a weak point opens the wrong book with the tag filter carried). The implementation does the opposite: - Weak-tag row click → `onDrillTag(t.tag)` → `onDrillToQuiz({bankId, tag})` → **quiz page byTag** (not wrong book). - The wrong-book drill ("查看错题本" button) → `onDrillToWrong?.({ bankId: bankId || undefined })` — carries **bankId only, never tag**. - Scorecard "查看错题" → `drillToWrong()` — no filter at all. `WrongBookPage` fully supports `initialFilter.tag` (lines 76–82), but no call site ever passes it. The executor's own summary confirms the deviation ("onDrillWrong 按钮→drillToWrong（bankId 筛选）"). So the explicit acceptance "错题本带 tag 筛选打开" is contradicted by the code, and was not remotely verified either. This is one of the four dedicated closure acceptance clauses; the other three (README columns, switchTab filter reset, single listWrong + loading) are all genuinely implemented. ## Required fixes 1. Make the 学情薄弱点 drill open 错题本 with the tag carried (pass tag through `onDrillToWrong({bankId, tag})` → `WrongBookPage initialFilter.tag`, e.g. add a per-weak-point "错题本" drill or change the weak-point click target), and verify the flow so clicking a weak point lands in the wrong book pre-filtered by that tag.
